title: Identify Illustrative Club Inputs and Their Evidence Provenance
body:
## Problem

Hybrid presets risk being mistaken for measured player or complete manufacturer specifications.

## Acceptance Criteria

Label assumed speed/mass/attack/7i loft, optimizer PW example, and static-lie to delivered-axis assumption in reports and receipts.

## Validation

Astra source audit and final calculation reference

## Handoff

Branch: `codex/shot-pattern-analysis`. Current implementation and evidence are tracked in `docs/research/shot_pattern_analysis/issues/README.md`. Keep open until a merged implementing PR satisfies acceptance criteria or an explicitly permitted disposition applies.
